newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 falls at fixing led by major issues.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 falls at fixing led by major issues.

text.p: Czech major issues fell back at Thursday's fixing losing most of the ground they had made on Wednesday and pulling the PX50 index down 0.36 percent to 493.3.

Dealers said the market was quiet with no new factors expected in the short or medium term and the continued absence of foreign investors hobbling any chance of a revival in the Prague bourse's fortunes.
"It's just the same old story. The foreigners need to be reassured by a better macro-economic picture and without them the market is basically stagnant," said one local dealer.
The most heavily capitalised Czech share, SPT Telecom, lost 10 crowns to 3,390, CEZ fell four crowns to 901, Komercni Banka was unchanged on 1,740 and Ceska Sporitelna was off one crown to 290.
The next major economic indicator, consumer price inflation, comes out on July 8.
